packages.title: Typed transition preservation
packages.objective: Package the supported type-level result, keep semantic claims out of scope, and present the packet for human review.
packages.why_it_exists: The live D frontier needs a clean C packet before D can be reviewed without inherited ambiguity.
assumptions: semantic representability is downstream of OBL-D-001D

execution_steps.description: Record the bounded type-level closure in an additive proof artifact.
Qualify the downstream wording so no semantic claim leaks in.
Assemble the negative-case and certificate packet for review.
Submit for explicit human review without fabricating approval.

acceptance_tests: No semantic-preservation wording remains in the C packet

packages.success_definition: A reviewer can approve or reject OBL-D-001C without reopening type-level ambiguity.
failure_conditions: semantic preservation is still attributed to C
human review is implied without evidence

escalation.if_blocked: Keep OBL-D-001C OPEN and state that only human review remains.
escalation.if_contradiction_found: Preserve both readings and reopen the packet.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Invalidate the type-preservation packet and reopen OBL-D-001C.
